items.description: The Reserve Bank of India has increased the cut-off yields for treasury bills after canceling a prior auction. Yields of the 91-day, 182-day, and 364-day bills experienced a significant rise. While system liquidity has dropped compared to last month, it still remains in a positive state. Traders are bracing for additional hikes as they face liquidity constraints and high oil prices, with the 10-year yield standing at 7.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty fall as IT stocks slide, rising oil prices weigh
items.description: Indian equity markets took a hit on Wednesday, primarily due to declines in the IT sector and escalating crude oil prices. Both the Sensex and Nifty closed lower, showcasing investors' cautious mood amidst significant intraday drops. Key downturns were influenced by Reliance Industries along with various IT stocks, but the auto sector and select banking stocks sparked some buying activities that alleviated part of the losses.

items.title: Sebi to review FPI rules, align with global norms
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India is set to release a consultation paper aimed at refining compliance requirements for foreign portfolio investors. Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey highlighted the progress in the onboarding of international funds while pointing out the heavy compliance burden in India. Sebi is also considering the possibility of self-listing for stock exchanges despite the challenges that may arise.

items.title: Fed holds rates, says data will guide next move
items.description: In their latest meeting, Federal Reserve officials decided to keep interest rates steady, reflecting a measured approach towards inflation concerns. Not all agreed, however; two officials pushed for an increase to counteract growing prices. Current economic indicators reveal robust growth, driven by increased consumer spending and investment. Analysts are keenly awaiting upcoming inflation data to better gauge the Fed's policy direction, which aims for a 2 percent inflation target.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany's KC Current to launch holiday light experience
items.author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
items.description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' co-owned KC Current will launch Light Up The Pitch, its first walk-through holiday light experience, at CPKC Stadium in Kansas City. Starting November 27, the five-weekend event will feature a 26-foot Christmas tree, teal light displays, a train depot and a larger-than-life Santa. Visitors can explore the festive attraction in about an hour, giving families a new holiday destination beyond the soccer season.
